question: #13192 at 1a2ff3a2 against main 7ee32e5f at 200% text: do nested SideNav rows with long labels and badges stay inside the nav, end in an ellipsis, and keep a full focus ring? Are the existing stories unchanged?

main.note: local Storybook build plus one scratch story (scratch-story.tsx), in neither pull request

headLocal.note: local Storybook build plus one scratch story (scratch-story.tsx), in neither pull request

stories.head: core-sidenav--nested-long-labels (the head preview)
stories.main: scratch-sidenav-nested-long-labels--nested-long-labels (a local build of main with scratch-story.tsx)
stories.headLocal: the same scratch story on a local build of the head (control)

method.rows: every visible .astryx-side-nav-item in the container (the nav, or the visible dialog for the flyout and the drawer); depth = the role=group elements around the row inside the container, so 1 is a top-level row here; the long label = the row's leaf with more than 30 characters; its room = the clientWidth of the element with text-overflow ellipsis, and its text width = the right end of the label text's Range box minus the label box's left edge, rounded
method.flyout: Collapse sidebar is clicked, then Projects; the visible dialog is read
method.drawer: 390 x 844 at scale 2; the first button named navigation or menu is clicked; the visible dialog is read
method.focus: from page start, Tab until focus is on a row two groups deep; the ring is the set of pixels that differ between the rest frame and the focus frame near the focused element; per side, along its straight part (12 px in from each corner), whether each position has ring pixels, and the band's pixels against the pixel 2 px outside it; the core is the strongest band pixel at a position
method.unchanged: default text size, 1280 x 800, each story's first frame on main's Production and the head's preview
